contexts.text: This great system, which is called the universe, is a work cohering as a one...
Such a system of theology as this...
(They said), God operates (only) universally in the whole system of our mind and body...
For faith enters into the parts of a system of theology, as the blood enters into the members of the body.
The whole system of theology of the present day is dependent on this imputation.
By which (the Christian Church) has fashioned its system.
This is in the general system of the World of Spirits.
Therefore... the universal system of man has been perverted.
The tone may be from the whole consonant bony system...
To one action... the universal system of the purer parts concurs...
It is the lungs which operate in general into the system of the muscles.
The soul (is conceived of) as dominant in its own systematic world.
